> Our tech lead (James) asked whether the +25% burst assumes continuous KV-cache compatibility across quantized variants — can Ben include a short note on performance assumptions?

Thanks Maya — quick note on that: the +25% uplift we modeled in the attachment assumes the following operational constraints:

- Model variant: MPT-30B quantized (8-bit per our recommended profile). We assume continuous KV cache reuse for conversational flows with median context length ~1024 tokens.
- Hardware: Dedicated A100-class GPUs for the steady-state. Burst capacity assumes temporary routing to mixed-precision T4/RTX pools with warmed KV caches for top-tier requests.
- Performance expectation: 5–12% latency variance during bursts for long sequences (>2k tokens); throughput scales linearly for generation-heavy workloads but depends on batch size and prefix cache hit-rate.

I'll prepare a one-page run-rate note and attach it to the Drive folder before the QBR — that'll include the cost delta table and SLO guidance for burst gating.

Also confirming Wed Jul 23, 09:00–10:00 PST for the QBR. Camila — do you want me to share the run-rate note in advance so James and Procurement can review?

—Ben
